What you get

From updating the score to showing it on screen, everything in one place.

🏏

Ball-by-ball scoring

Runs, wides, no-balls, wickets and extras in one tap. The balls of the over appear as chips on screen.

📺

vMix / OBS overlay

Add the public overlay link to your broadcast. The score updates automatically.

📊

CRR, RRR and target

For chases, NEED, RRR, PROJECTED and partnership are shown live too.

🔗

Captain link

Every team gets its own link. The captain adds players (name required, photo optional) and sends the Playing XI for each match. No login needed.

📱

Android app

Install the app on your phone and update the score from anywhere.

🎨

Multiple themes

A different look for every match. Choose a theme for your event or sponsor.

Pricing

Plans for one machine. Click "Buy now" under a plan; payment is processed on Razorpay.

How you get the app

After you pay, the APK download link is sent to your email. For help, call 9986095581 or email itclive1@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Which sports are supported?

Cricket, Kabaddi, Football, Wrestling and Bailgada Sharyat.

How do I add the overlay?

The app gives you a public overlay link. Add it to vMix or OBS as a Browser source.

Can more than one person update the score at the same time?

Each plan is for one machine. For more users or channels, email us at itclive1@gmail.com.

Is there a free trial?

No. There is no free trial. Please read the Refund Policy before you pay.

How do I get access after payment?

After payment, download the APK, install it, then call 9986095581. Your access will be activated after the call.

Can a plan be cancelled or refunded?

Yes, under the conditions in the Refund Policy below.

How do I get updates?

Most updates reach the app automatically. If we release a new APK, we will share the download link by email.

How do I get support?

Email us at itclive1@gmail.com and we will reply.

Refund Policy

There is no free trial.

If you have not used the app, you can get a refund. Email itclive1@gmail.com to request it.

If you have used the app within 2 days of activation, no refund will be given.

Access is activated only after you call 9986095581 after installing the APK.

Privacy Policy

We store your name, mobile number, password (in hashed form), an optional selfie, and the match data you enter in the app.

Match data stays on your device. Live match data needed for the overlay is kept on our server.

We do not sell your data. To ask for your data to be deleted, email itclive1@gmail.com.

Terms

Access is activated after payment and a phone call to 9986095581. Access lasts for the period of the plan you bought.

The app is for scoring cricket, kabaddi, football, wrestling and bailgada sharyat matches. We may update the app to improve it.

We are not responsible for problems caused by internet or device issues.
